profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Greenway Health
profile.summary:
I am a self-taught software developer. After graduating from the University of Florida with a B.S. degree in Journalism, I began spending my free time studying computer programming. Computers have always interested me; I initially wanted to pursue a career in technology journalism. After learning some basic HTML, CSS and Javascript for journalism, I got exposed to the world of programming and found it to be an immensely rewarding hobby. 

In my free time, I enjoy improving my skills in programming, making/playing video games and traveling.

projects.title: ¿Quién es el Mechaburro?
projects.description: A singleplayer/local multiplayer game (up to 4 players) with bots made in Rust using the Bevy game engine. It was made in a week as an entry for the first Bevy game jam following the theme of "Unfair Advantage." It was rated 2nd place out of 74 games submitted.

projects.title: Not Snake (Multi-platform video game made in Rust)
projects.description:
A game made in Rust using the Bevy game engine. Playable in Windows, Linux, Mac and in Chrome.

Code can be found here:
https://github.com/ramirezmike/not_snake_game
